title: SEA-SafeguardBench: Evaluating AI Safety in SEA Languages and Cultures

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the prompt and response safety classification performance (e.g., AUPRC, F1, Safe Response Rate) of LLMs and safeguard models across English and seven Southeast Asian languages (Indonesian, Malay, Burmese, Thai, Tamil, Tagalog, and Vietnamese) to measure cross-lingual generalization and performance disparities.

Evaluating model safety classification and response generation on natively authored, culturally-grounded prompts that reflect local norms, taboos, religious beliefs, and region-specific socio-political sensitivities in Southeast Asia, comparing performance against general, Western-centric safety prompts.
